body:
## Problem / why
The current integration baseline is red before BI-PF-1567 changes are considered. Precheck reports seven new open items without api_impact/epic/detailed AC (BI-PF-1603..BI-PF-1609), 112 backlog-context problems across open items, and a completed BI-PF-1566 that lacks Gate 2/Gate 2.5 and completion trail evidence. This blocks every delivery branch, including otherwise green work.

## Goal & value
Restore a trustworthy baseline so feature branches can merge on their own merits, and close the authority/bookkeeping drift that made completed work look invalid.

## In scope
- Repair BI-PF-1603 through BI-PF-1609: epic, context, detailed AC, api_impact with reason/routes.
- Repair open product_forge backlog context until backlog-context passes.
- Reconcile DB/file projections and generated docs under both PF_BACKLOG_DB=on and off.
- Re-run precheck fast and prove the baseline is green.

## Out of scope
- BI-PF-1567 memory-orchestrator implementation.
- New product features or schema changes.
- Reopening rejected BI-PF-1538.

## Closure note
The BI-PF-1566/1550 completion failures were false transitions caused by a stale local develop ref plus our own inspection edits; no HIL Gate 2 approval was fabricated. Repairing the local develop ref restored zero-transition checks.

brief.why: Green feature work is blocked by repository debt unrelated to the feature code, and the drift hides whether completion gates are real.
brief.problem: Feature branches cannot merge because the shared baseline has unscoped items, incomplete context, and invalid completion evidence.
brief.what_adds: A single remediation pass that repairs item metadata, backlog context, BI-PF-1566 gate/trail evidence, and projection parity.
brief.who_feels: Every worker and reviewer blocked by precheck, plus operators who cannot trust completed status.

label: PF Backlog 712
risks: Bulk backlog edits can overwrite newer DB state; use the API and verify parity after each repair.
Completion evidence must be factual; do not fabricate Gate 2 approval for BI-PF-1566.
Projection regeneration can touch unrelated scopes; stage only baseline-remediation artifacts.
